items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Well, the way, I think the way Hotacalla does that is really nice.

ctx.x: And we got it now. I got confused. Yeah.

Well, the way, I think the way Hotacalla does that is really nice. Police are up for them. Yeah. The way they're there, they put the three trumpets in the back. The two drums. The way they do it. I mean, I think that's really nice. That's really nice the way they do that. I like the way they have that set up. Police are up for them. What do you call that band? Eureka.
